rules_text: The Whit Merrifield Memorial Cup
Purpose

The Whit Merrifield Memorial Cup is a fantasy baseball game that uses limited rosters and daily fantasy scoring to be played in conjunction with the season-long rotisserie League. The game will consist of a subset of a Franchise’s rotisserie League players competing in a Cup format of round robin play followed by an elimination tournament.
Format
The WMMC will start 10 weeks prior to the All-Star Break. Franchises will be organized into pools in the following fashion:
Franchises will be first categorized into Pots based on prior year’s finishing position.
Pot 1 will be 1st-3rd place
Pot 2 will be 4th-6th place
Pot 3 will be 7th-9th place
Pot 4 will be 10th-12th place
The three players in Pot 1 are the top 3 finishers from the prior year. They will draft their pools in snake order.

Player Selection
The WMMC will require that Owners select a specific number of batters and pitchers for the entirety of each “round” to represent their Franchise.
Owners will select 4 batters and 3 starting pitchers that will accumulate points using DFS scoring for the current round.
At the conclusion of each round, players can be swapped in or out.
If a player is traded or dropped from an owner’s GET team, they must be replaced in WMMC.
Injured players can be replaced if they receive an official IL designation, but cannot be subbed back in until the next round unless they are used to replace another dropped/traded/injured player.
Each owner is allowed one free player swap per round, in addition to normal status change swaps.
For playoff rounds, owners are restricted to one drop swap per round.
There are no limits on the number of times a player can be selected.
All replacement player requests must be filed to the Commissioners office and confirmed by the Commissioner.
Schedule
The schedule will look like this:
10 Weeks from All-Star Break - Pool Play 1 starts (5 weeks)
5 Weeks from All-Star Break - Pool Play 2 starts (5 weeks)
Sunday Before All-Star Break - Pool Play ends (1 week break)
Week after All-Star Break - Quarterfinals (2 weeks)
Week after Quarterfinals - Semifinals (2 weeks)
Week after Semifinals - Finals and 3rd-Place Game(2 weeks each, concurrently)
Pool Play
Each Owner will score points using Daily Fantasy Scoring for two 5 week periods per DraftKings scoring system.
Owners can select or change players for the second five week period, but the pools will remain the same.
Pool Play Advancement Rules -
The winners of Pool Play 1 and Pool Play 2 (referred to as PP1 & PP2), per pool, will automatically advance to the Quarterfinals (a maximum of 6 total teams)
Wildcard Selection:
Top 2 high-scoring non PP winners will be automatically selected as Wildcards
If a pool’s PP1 champion is also PP2 champion, select next highest overall scoring team from any pool
Elimination Play
After pool play finishes, Owners will be seeded accordingly:
Pool Play Winners by overall score
Wildcards by overall score
There will be three rounds of two-week single-elimination games.
Round 1 (Quarterfinals)
Round 2 (Semifinals)
Round 3 (Finals)
The bracket will progress as follows, and will not reseed after each round.
First seed vs. eighth seed (QF1)
Fourth seed vs. fifth seed (QF2)
Third seed vs. sixth seed (QF 3)
Second Seed vs. seventh seed (QF4)
QF1 winner vs. QF2 winner (SF1)
QF3 winner vs. QF4 winner (SF2)
SF1 winner vs. SF2 winner (Final)
SF1 loser vs SF2 loser (3rd place game)
Owners will use the same rules in terms of setting lineups and replacing players
